turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
est, Skylar

How long will delivery take, roughly?

Most orders arrive within about a week of being placed. We generally prepare your order in 1-4 business days, and shipping usually takes another 1-5 days depending on the shipping method you choose. Occasionally, it can take up to 12-14 days—especially during busy times. If you need it extra speedy, our A Bit Faster shipping option is your best bet! Let me know if you want more details on specific products or shipping options.

turns.q: And if I change my mind, how easy is it to return?
turns.replyTail:
mind, returning is pretty straightforward! You have 30 days from delivery to start a return as long as your item is unused and in new condition. Just head to our online Returns Portal to get started, or you can bring your online order to one of our stores for a quick return—just have your order number handy.
